metadata.case_name: YEUNG TSZ MAN v. EVERBEST PORT SERVICES LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

injuries.description: angulated fracture of the middle phalanx of left ring finger
source: a 1.5 cm laceration with active bleeding and swelling was noted over his left ring finger. X-ray examination revealed an angulated fracture of the middle phalanx on his left ring finger.
X-ray showed fracture middle phalanx of left ring finger.
middle phalanx fracture was fixed with K-wire.

injuries.description: contusion of ulnar side neurovascular bundle of left ring finger
source: Ulnar side neurovascular bundle was found contused
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of wrist or hand

injuries.description: 1.5 cm laceration / open wound over left ring finger
source: a 1.5 cm laceration with active bleeding and swelling was noted over his left ring finger.
Physical examination revealed open wound over his left ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of finger or thumb

manifestations.description: tension of the muscles of and pain over his left ring finger
reduced and limited mobility of the left ring finger
reduced left power grip and left power pinch grip
numbness over his left ring finger
stiffness over his left ring finger
aggravated pain during rainy and/or cold weather
sleep occasionally disturbed throughout the night due to pain and discomfort
concentration and temper during the day adversely affected

treatments_received: Emergency operation: middle phalanx fracture was fixed with K-wire
An external splint was prescribed for protection of fracture
Orthopaedic follow-up at Princess Margaret Hospital (from 17 September 2013 to 16 May 2014)
Occupational therapy (attended 4 sessions at Princess Margaret Hospital from 13 September 2013 to 8 November 2013; attended 19 sessions at Tuen Mun Hospital from 28 January 2014 to 15 May 2014)
Physiotherapy (attended 21 sessions at Tuen Mun Hospital from 3 December 2013 to 15 May 2014)
Work hardening training / work rehabilitation program

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: reduced and limited mobility of the left ring finger affecting left power grip and left power pinch grip when twisting the towel during washing, or when picking up objects over 12 lbs

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: time spent on outdoor activities such as playing basketball reduced from at least 3 to 4 times a month to minimal
social life has been adversely affected
concentration and temper during the day have been adversely affected

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheung Kit Ching v Mountains International Company Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff suffered injury to her left middle finger in an accident. She was found to have comminuted fracture involving tuft of distal phalanges of left middle phalanx, with mild bony displacement and soft tissue swelling.

comparable_cases.case_name: Shah Junaid Ali v Yau Lee Galvanizers (Hot-Dip) Company Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: injured his left middle finger... diagnosed with crush injury to the left middle finger. There was a 1.5 cm laceration over the distal pulp region of the finger. X-ray examination showed crack fracture of the distal phalanx. Suturing and irrigation were performed. He attended 32 sessions of occupational therapy and was given 9 months' sick leave.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Ming Yat v Youh Eng Lai Michael trading as Prime Industrial Company (Hong Kong)
comparable_cases.injury_description: open fracture of the proximal phalanx of the left index finger, dislocation of the interphalangeal joint of the same finger, ruptured ulnar collateral ligament of the proximal interphalangeal joint and contused ulnar digital nerve and artery. He underwent emergency operation involving wound debridgment and fracture fixation.

comparable_cases.case_name: Khan Irram v Wai Hing Engineering Company Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: distal phalange of his left ring finger was swollen with bruises. X-ray examination showed a fracture at the distal phalange. He was discharged on the same day with analgesics and given 15 days' sick leave.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Hung Hang v Fat Kee Marine Repairing & Engineering Co Limited & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: crush injury to his right middle finger...bruise and tenderness over the tip of the right middle finger and subungual haematoma over nail. There was also fracture of the tuft of distal phalanx of the right middle finger.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Yun San v Cheung Yue Yiu trading as Radio Engineering Co
comparable_cases.injury_description: injured his left index and middle fingers...sustained crush injuries, pulp loss in his left index finger and a deep laceration in the middle finger exposing extensor tendon over proximal interphalangeal joint. Open reduction, internal fixation and extensor repair surgery was performed. Further operation to resurface the left index finger with a local flap advanced to cover the defect in the finger by way of skin graft taken from the wrist was carried out.
